name: The Kit
hint: Drums are mirrors, and only the head reflects: hit a drum from behind and the shell swallows the wave. Watch which way each head faces. The kettle drum is tuned with B — find the phrase the lock wants.

solution.why: the tee lights the fork below it; the top drum's head faces down-left so the wave bounces down, and the bottom one's faces up-left so it bounces left to the other fork
tune the kettle drum up: it plays 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and the lock hears 3-4-5 (scale degrees counted from 0)
